title: Agent session, TinyStories, 20 to 21 October 2026
note: 49 experiments by the agent in a 10-hour session of 10-minute runs, from late on 20 October to the afternoon of 21 October 2026, from the starter recipe (full attention, the starter kit's since 20 October), on TinyStories with its own tokenizer. It paused from 03:20 to 07:27 when the agent's sign-in expired. The first recipe was trained three times to measure the noise.
